questions.question_text: Understanding Budget BasicsWhat is the primary purpose of creating a budget for an event?

options.text: To spend as much money as possible on decorations
To track income and expenses to avoid overspending
To impress friends with expensive event elements
To ignore costs and focus only on ticket sales

correct_answer.text: To track income and expenses to avoid overspending

questions.question_text: BudgetSpreadsheetComponentsWhich of the following is NOT a typical column in a budget spreadsheet for an event?
Fundraising StrategiesWhich of the following is a creative fundraising idea suitable for high school students organizing an event?

options.text: Taking out a large bank loan
Setting up a themed car wash or mehndi stall at school
Ignoring the need for funds and hoping for donations

correct_answer.text: Setting up a themed car wash or mehndi stall at school

questions.question_text: Cost-Cutting TechniquesWhat is a cost-cutting tip mentioned for reducing event expenses without sacrificing quality?

options.text: Buying the most expensive decorations to impress guests
Borrowing equipment like speakers from friends or school instead of renting
Spending all the budget on food and ignoring other needs
Printing hundreds of flyers even if digital promotion is free

correct_answer.text: Borrowing equipment like speakers from friends or school instead of renting
